subject.title: fix: models status auth, browser local-file nav, codex workspace app-server, tui empty sessions

question: Should Codex app-server workspace-write turns gain network egress by default, or stay network-denied unless explicitly opted in?
rationale: The PR changes an existing sandbox boundary for all workspace-write app-server turns, and code review cannot safely infer maintainer security/product intent for that default.

options.title: Keep default denied
options.body: Keep workspace-write networkAccess false by default and require a separate explicit opt-in or approved config path for network-enabled app-server turns.

options.title: Accept new default
options.body: Allow workspace-write app-server turns to use outbound network by default, with maintainer-owned docs, upgrade notes, and real scenario proof.

options.title: Split the PR
options.body: Move TUI/browser/auth repairs separately from the sandbox default change so the narrower fixes can proceed while the security decision stays open.

recommendation.title: Keep default denied
recommendation.body: Keep workspace-write networkAccess false by default and require a separate explicit opt-in or approved config path for network-enabled app-server turns.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the clearest recent area contributor for the Codex app-server config and models-status auth surfaces from current-main blame and PR metadata.
